meera.title: Medical conditions
meera.text:
I have profound hearing loss in both ears since birth.
I have type 1 diabetes, diagnosed in 2014.
I have mild asthma that gets worse in winter.

meera.title: Allergies
meera.text:
Medicine allergy: penicillin causes a skin rash and swelling.
Food allergy: peanuts.
I have no latex allergy.

meera.title: Current medicines
meera.text:
Insulin glargine 18 units every night at 10 pm.
Insulin aspart 6 units before each meal.
Salbutamol inhaler 2 puffs when wheezing.

meera.text:
